correctness.rationale: The exact weak-composition universe has 715 and 1001 vectors, respectively; every received (n-1)-multiset is a 5-parent clique and a pair conflicts precisely under one unit transfer. Independent exact enumeration reproduced 495 and 715 shadows, 4950 and 7150 distinct pair-conflicts and valid syndrome-zero codewords of sizes 143 and 201. Four supplied *complete*, not sampled, MIP models in actual verification/ programs explicitly implement binary constraints and zero integrality gap, with source-recorded HiGHS dual upper bounds 143 and 201 below the next integer. The independently reconstructed n=10 MIP also returned primal=dual=201 and zero gap; a new n=9 solver rerun timed out, not treated as negative evidence. Thus the numerical upper bound is conditional on trusted HiGHS branch-and-bound semantics, not a standalone rational certificate. It is not extrapolated beyond n=10.
residual_risks: No independently checkable exact rational dual/branch-and-bound certificate; lower-bound witnesses independently checked; n9 independent MILP rerun timed out, but supplied model and successful original dual-bounds inspected.
Published optimizer logs are floating-point HiGHS output; source code inspected; global upper bound is conditional on solver correctness.
